name: both-branches-return
source:
using Supprocom.NativeAllocationManagement;
public static class Sample { public static void Run(bool condition) { NativeConcurrentPool<int> pool = new(); if (condition) { pool.ReturnMemoryToNativeMemory(); } else { pool.ReturnMemoryToNativeMemory(); } pool.LeaseFromMemory(); ConcurrentPooled<int> value = pool.Rent(1, static writer => writer.Fill(default!)); value.Dispose(); pool.Dispose(); } }

name: post-return-operations
source:
using Supprocom.NativeAllocationManagement;
public static class Sample { public static void Run() { NativeConcurrentPool<int> pool = new(); ConcurrentPooled<int> stale = pool.Rent(2, static writer => writer.Fill(default!)); pool.ReturnMemoryToNativeMemory(); _ = stale.Length; _ = stale.Capacity; stale.Clear(); stale.CopyFrom(new int[2]); stale.CopyTo(new int[2]); stale.Access(static _ => { }); _ = stale.Read(static span => span[0]); stale.Dispose(); pool.Dispose(); } }

public static class Sample { public static void Run() { var first = new NativeConcurrentPool<int>(); var second = new NativeConcurrentPool<long>(); first.ReturnMemoryToGarbageCollector(); second.ReturnMemoryToNativeMemory(); first.LeaseFromMemory(); second.LeaseFromMemory(); var firstValue = first.Rent(1, static writer => writer.Fill(default!)); var secondValue = second.Rent(1, static writer => writer.Fill(default!)); firstValue.Dispose(); secondValue.Dispose(); first.Dispose(); second.Dispose(); } }

name: balanced-generation-goto-retry
source:
using Supprocom.NativeAllocationManagement;
public static class Sample { public static void Run(int iterations) { NativeConcurrentPool<int> pool = new(); int completed = 0; Retry: if (completed == iterations) { goto Done; } completed++; pool.ReturnMemoryToNativeMemory(); pool.LeaseFromMemory(); goto Retry; Done: pool.Dispose(); } }
